config.data: training observations = (train positions x train time fractions) plus states visited by the unmodified recipient, the donor-dependent PCA patch and the donor from all 62 starts, restricted to train positions and excluding held-out time fractions. Validation: dev positions x all 21 times (position holdout) and train positions x held-out times (time holdout).
config.minimum_rank_rule: smallest rank whose mean direct-goal rate over the three training seeds is >= 0.95 on all 62 starts (exploratory: every start was analyzed in earlier phases)

transfer.pair_rule: recipient = first checkpoint with farm-only >= 0.90 on all 62 starts; donor = latest earlier checkpoint with the highest direct-goal rate (from results/phase4_6/reclassification.json). Applied to all seeds; seed 123 gives 20k -> 30k.
